title: Batch export no longer puts another photo into some outputs: colour and luminance masks are built from the image being exported, and masks are paired with the right adjustments
notes: Only exports with colour/luminance masks (or an empty mask before another mask) change: they now match the editor. Prior art: R-Laine/RapidRAW@d49c341 (same path-keyed idea, different base).
highlight: **Reliable batch exports.** Large exports no longer slip another photo into some images, and colour and luminance masks now apply correctly when exporting.
